8.31.2.7. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.protection.FrontProtectionObject.isInDomain¶

FrontProtectionObject.isInDomain(*args)¶

Return True is the objects the tuple args are in the domains of the corresponding geo type in the signature.

Parameters:args (vtuple(IRailyardComponent)) – A tuple of objects to be checked.
Return type:bool
Returns:Return True if every object in the tuple args is in the domain of the geo type in the signature of the predicate.
